• The broad family of chemical molecules known as aromatic compounds, which includes **benzene**, has its origins in this substance.
 
• In contrast to **cyclohexane**, benzene only has **six hydrogen atoms,** which gives the perception that the ring is unsaturated and that each carbon atom is a part of one double bond.
 
• For benzene, two distinct **configurations **with alternating single and double bonds around the **ring **are possible.
 
• There are 9 single bonds and 3 double bonds between alternate carbon atoms in benzene **(C₆H₆). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• A double bond is formed when the two atoms share two sets of electrons.
 
• **Electron **pair sharing is **constant**.
 
• A shared pair of electrons constitutes a **covalent bond.**
 
• Because the **two atoms **sharing a **double bond **share four electrons, it takes more energy to break a double bond than a single one.

questions.question: Find the positive difference between the roots of the equation 2x² - 7x + 5 = 0.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A quadratic equation(2x² - 7x + 5 = 0) 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have 2x² -7x + 5 = 0 

⇒ 2x² -2x -5x + 5 = 0 

⇒ 2x ( x -1) - 5( x -1) = 0 

⇒ (2x -5) (x -1) = 0 

⇒ 2x -5 = 0 and (x - 1) = 0 

⇒ x = 5/2 and x = 1 

So, the two roots of the equation are 5/2 and 1 

Their positive difference = 5/2 -1 = 3/2 

**Hence, the required difference between the roots is 3/2.**

questions.question:
Which of the following interchanges of numbers would make the given equation correct?

2 × 10 ÷ 8 + 6 - 4 = 9
questions.solution:
BODMAS table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2931a6028de7a7568e7b38fd9d0c79295d0e418e064717c7c8d0d9d94e5635f0.png] 

Given equation: 2 × 10 ÷ 8 + 6 - 4 = 9

Let's check all the options

**1) 2, 4**

Apply the changes

⇒ 4 × __**10 ÷ 8**__ + 6 - 2 = 9

Use BODMAS rule

⇒ __**4 × 1.25**__ + 6 - 2 = 9

⇒ __**5 + 6**__ - 2 = 9

⇒ __**11 - 2**__ = 9

**⇒ 9 = 9, true**

 

2) 6, 8

Apply the changes

⇒ 2 × __**10 ÷ 6**__ + 8 - 4 = 9

Use BODMAS rule

⇒ __**2 × 1.66**__ + 8 - 4 = 9

⇒ __3.33 + 8__ - 4 = 9

⇒ __**11.33 - 4**__ = 9

⇒ 7.33 = 9, false

 

3) 9,10

Apply the changes

⇒ 2 × __**9 ÷ 8**__ + 6 - 4 = 10

Use BODMAS rule

⇒ __**2 × 1.125**__ + 6 - 4 = 10

⇒ __2.25 + 6__ - 4 = 10

⇒ __**8.25 - 4**__ = 10

⇒ 4.25 = 10, false

 

4) 2, 8

Apply the changes

⇒ 8 × __**10 ÷ 2**__ + 6 - 4 = 9

Use BODMAS rule

⇒ __**8 × 5**__ + 6 - 4 = 9

⇒ __40 + 6__ - 4 = 9

⇒ __**46 - 4**__ = 9

⇒ 42 = 9, false

 

So, the numbers **2, 4** are interchanged to get the correct answer. 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.

• The **nonpotable water can be filtered for use as drinking water** and utilized to** irrigate lawns, wash automobiles, wash clothes, and flush toilets.**

__
 
• **There is frequently a sizable annual temperature range in continental climates (warm summers and cold winters).**
 
• They typically occur in **big landmasses at intermediate latitudes (40 to 55 north)**, when prevailing winds blow overland and bring some precipitation, and where seas do not act as a **temperature regulator.**
 
• Because of the** substantial landmasses **present there, continental climates are primarily found in the **Northern Hemisphere**.
 
• **Precipitation in continental regions typically occurs in moderate amounts, mainly during the warmer months.**

• Compared to **tropical climates,** where such fluctuations are frequently minimal and typically simply involve changes in precipitation, **these zones typically have greater temperature ranges throughout the year and more pronounced seasonal changes.**
 
 
 
• **Extreme Climate**
 
 
• ​Unexpected, uncommon, severe, or out-of-season weather as well as the **weather at the extremes of the historical distribution—the range that has been experienced in the past—are examples of extreme weather or extreme climate occurrences.**
 
• Extreme events are frequently characterized as occurring in the top ten percent of all observed occurrences based on a location's historical meteorological data.
 
• **The three main categories of extreme weather are tropical cyclones, heat waves, and cold waves.**
 
 
 
• **Maritime Climate**

• It is characterized by generally cool summers and mild winters (for their latitude), with a relatively **narrow annual temperature range and few temperature extremes.**

• **Force** is of two types:

 
 
• Contact force
 
• Non-contact force
 
 
 
• **Contact force** is a force that acts on a body either directly or through a medium.
 
 
• Examples: Muscular force, Mechanical force, Frictional force.
 
 
 
• **Non-contact force** is a force that makes contact without direct contact.
 
 
• Examples: Gravitational force, Electrostatic force, Magnetic force.
